# Thieves
[color=#999999][italic]"Yoink! I'll be taking that! And that! Ooh, don't mind if I do!"[/italic][/color]
Thieves are petty but cunning [color=green]criminals[/color] who cannot resist other people's belongings. After your last arrest, you were fitted with a [bold]pacifism implant[/bold], but that will not stop you from expanding your collection.
## The Art of Theft Unlike other antagonists, [bold]it is important not to get caught[/bold], because the implant will not let you attack without cause. You can only fight your way out if [color=#cb0000]Security[/color] starts the fight, and since you work alone, nobody will help you get out of trouble.
Even so, with persistence, sleight of hand, a few tools, and your [color=cyan]pickpocketing skills[/color], you can successfully make off with whatever you want.
These skills give you an edge: [bold]you can take things from people without them even noticing.[/bold] With practice, you can lift a wallet and keep the conversation going.
You should wear gloves, or your fingerprints will give you away.
## Tools of the Trade You have two more advantages: a [color=cyan]beacon[/color] and a [color=cyan]satchel[/color].
The [color=cyan]beacon[/color] safely sends home treasures that are too cumbersome to carry during evacuation. Find a secluded spot, deploy the beacon, and set the hideout coordinates. At the end of the shift, all valuable items nearby will be [bold]teleported to your vault,[/bold] completing your objective.
However, if someone finds it, it will instantly give you away and make recovering the stolen goods easy. [bold]Hide it carefully![/bold]
The [color=cyan]satchel[/color] can hold... anything you manage to grab. [bold]You can choose two kits[/bold] to pull off the perfect heist.
## The Centerpiece of the Collection Kleptomania will take you far. One day you will steal figurines; the next, a huge industrial machine.
It does not matter: sooner or later, everything will end up in the collection.
You can steal items if [bold]you have them on you when you arrive at CentComm.[/bold] Otherwise, leave large items next to the beacon—[bold]it will transfer them to your vault.[/bold]
Some [italic]living[/italic] targets will be reluctant to cooperate. Make sure they are alive and with you or the beacon at the end of the shift.
